refs.X:
Shrek Forever After, also known as Shrek 4 or Shrek: The Final Chapter, was released in the United States on May 21, 2010. It is an animated comedy film and the fourth installment in the Shrek film series. The movie was produced by DreamWorks Animation and distributed by Paramount Pictures.

In this final chapter, Shrek finds himself in an alternate universe where he was never born and must restore his world and reclaim his true love, Fiona, before time runs out. The film features the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy, Cameron Diaz, and Antonio Banderas, among others.
